subject.title: fix(codex): cap compaction override warning cache via createDedupeCache

question: Should the Codex ignored-compaction diagnostic retain at most 4096 distinct keys with LRU eviction and possible re-warning, or use a different bounded lifecycle?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but repository and upstream evidence do not establish 4096 as a contractual cardinality or determine the preferred post-eviction operator experience.

options.title: Accept 4096-key LRU
options.body: Merge the current bounded lifecycle, accepting rare re-warning after more than 4096 distinct ignored-override combinations.

options.title: Choose another bound
options.body: Set an owner-approved capacity or TTL and align the named constant, lifecycle comment, test, and live proof.

options.title: Retain process-lifetime suppression
options.body: Decline the patch and preserve warn-once-for-process behavior despite unbounded distinct-key retention.

recommendation.title: Accept 4096-key LRU
recommendation.body: Merge the current bounded lifecycle, accepting rare re-warning after more than 4096 distinct ignored-override combinations.
